restore_order: Install the applications and the Hindsight coding-agent runtime using their official installers; installed binaries and package caches are not copied.
Initialize 9router once, then stop it before restoring its exported configuration tables.
Render with a private values file and optionally --restore-router. OAuth/account stores were excluded and require fresh login.
Start EasyLlama and 9router-local, review localhost API/model reachability, then reload and start the Hindsight user services.
Start a new Codex session after the local services and coding-agent runtime are available.
hindsight_data: Only empty persistent-data directories are created. Database contents and the imported corpus require a separate private backup.
hindsight_images: Pinned image digests and resource limits are preserved in the compose.yaml template.
